pages.title: Solar Panels & Solar Companies in Corona, CA (2026)
pages.note: Existing legacy companies page moved onto the sourced growth template: SCE vs City of Corona utility split, Corona Utilities NEM cap (March 2024) and ERG schedule, eTRAKiT expedited and Symbium permit routes. Cost twin /solar-cost/corona stays (citycost lane).

folded into /solar-companies/corona: /solar-savings/corona is a 301 source (canonical-redirects.ts -> /solar-cost/corona); never build at a redirect source. The provider and rate questions (electricity provider corona, electric rates corona, solar electric system corona) are answered on /solar-companies/corona (City of Corona tiered rate, SCE vs City utility).

pages.title: Solar Panels & Solar Companies in Orange County, CA (2026)
pages.note: New region page (growth entry with region table): utility and CCA by city (SCE, SDG&E, Anaheim, OCPA), County of Orange permits for unincorporated areas, SB 379 automated-permit schedule. Links every live OC city page and the /solar-savings/orange-county hub. Also corrected /solar-savings/orange-county: Huntington Beach left OCPA (returned to SCE 2024).

pages.title: Solar Panels & Solar Companies in Huntington Beach, CA (2026)
pages.note: Corrected a Tier 1 factual error: the page said Huntington Beach is an OCPA member city; OCPA says the city left (vote May 2023) and customers returned to SCE in 2024 (solar accounts April 2024). Rewrote billing to SCE Solar Billing Plan; added HCD permit section for mobile/manufactured homes (GSC queries).

pages.title: Solar Panels & Solar Companies in San Mateo, CA (2026)
pages.note: Tier 1 page kept; added the City's 2024 SB 379 permit figures (333 permits, 47% storage, 31% online), County-vs-city permit FAQ, and links to the new San Mateo County page and maintenance cost page (GSC: solar panel maintenance san mateo).

pages.title: Solar Panels & Solar Companies in San Francisco, CA (2026)
pages.note: Tier 1 page kept; added 2024 SB 379 permit figures (887 permits, 17% online) and a link to the new Bay Area companies page for the bay-area sub-question.

pages.title: Solar Panels & Solar Companies in San Mateo County, CA (2026)
pages.note: New county page: PG&E + WestLight across the county, County of San Mateo Symbium instant permits for unincorporated homes, and each city's 2024 SB 379 permit counts/online share. Impressions land on /solar-companies/san-mateo, which now links here.

pages.title: Bay Area Solar Companies: How to Compare Quotes (2026)
pages.note: New region page (Tier 1 skipped it for lack of a region template): CCA or city utility by city (Ava, MCE, CleanPowerSF, SJCE, SVCE, WestLight, SCP, 3CE; Palo Alto, Santa Clara, Alameda munis) and each city's SB 379 permit figures. Carries the Marin County section (row 25 folded here).

folded into /solar-companies/bay-area: a standalone Marin page could not carry enough sourced local content (MCE and County of Marin sites return 403); the Bay Area page has a Marin section with San Rafael's SolarAPP+/OpenGov route, MCE per the CEC map and SB 379 counts for San Rafael, Corte Madera and San Anselmo.

pages.title: Bay Area Solar Savings & PG&E Rates by City (2026)
pages.note: Added PG&E rate and bill section (33.7c average, Base Services Charge, arrears), how solar changes the bill, 3-question FAQ with FAQPage schema, link to /solar-companies/bay-area; retitled toward rates + savings.

pages.title: San Diego Electric Bills & SDG&E Rates (2026)
pages.note: Tier 1 bills page already answers per-month and why-so-expensive; added a per-kWh FAQ (45.5c SDG&E average vs SCE/PG&E, EV-TOU-5 4-9 pm on-peak) for how much is electricity in san diego.

pages.title: Solar Panels & Solar Companies in Simi Valley, CA (2026)
